name: Ghost Cursor
description: A cartoon ghost that follows the pointer with a lagging, skewing and stretching body, squishing eyes, a mouth that opens with speed, and a wavy gooey hem, on a full-screen colored backdrop.
contents: Ghost with eyes, mouth and animated rippling bottom edge
behavior: Ghost eases toward the mouse or touch position each frame
Body skews and stretches with velocity, eyes squish and mouth grows with speed
Pressing the mouse button squints the eyes and flips the mouth
Ripple hem animates with a looping keyframe through a gooey SVG filter
editableByProps: Ghost size, follow lag, skew and stretch intensity
Eye squish and hem ripple count, spacing and speed

needsCodeEdit.change: Change eye or mouth size and shape

fixed: Backdrop covers the whole viewport with fixed positioning and ignores pointer events
Window listeners for mouse and touch are added on mount and removed on unmount
Mousedown default is prevented on the window
